content.comment_body: Does anyone know the allowed frequency for the "Input R" and "Input Dir" terminals in the up/down counter function of [product_name] [article_no]? The manual only provides information about the frequency for the "Input Cnt" input.

analysis.insight_summary: A user requests technical details on permissible input frequencies for 'Input R' and 'Input Dir' within the up/down counter function of a [product_name] [article_no] device, mentioning that the available documentation covers only 'Input Cnt'. This absence of comprehensive specifications creates uncertainty about proper configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects thorough documentation specifying frequency limits for every input on the up/down counter, not just for 'Input Cnt'.
